h01.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h01.content: He gazes tenderly at a glass jar of sourdough starter on the kitchen counter, both hands cupped around it.

h02.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h02.content: He stands small in the middle of a garage packed floor to ceiling with hobby equipment: a floor loom, ukuleles hung in a row, a beekeeping suit on a hook, easels, fishing rods, a telescope.

h03.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h03.content: At the front door he signs a delivery clipboard while an enormous wooden crate on a hand truck towers beside the delivery person.

h04.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h04.content: Close-up: he stands before a wall of labeled craft supply bins, overwhelmed, one hand on his beard.

h05.content: Product shot from a television pharmaceutical commercial: an amber prescription pill bottle with a clean white label; the label reads HOBBYSTATIN in large letters, and beneath it in smaller letters LOOMIVIR and EXTENDED RELEASE TABLETS 25 mg; the bottle stands on a seamless soft white studio background, bathed in warm golden light, gentle glow, photorealistic.

h06.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h06.content: He sits at a single pottery wheel in a cleared, sunlit garage, hands shaping wet clay, deeply content; warm color blooming into the scene.

h07.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h07.content: He hands a cardboard box of craft supplies to a delighted neighbor over the fence, more boxes stacked beside him, golden afternoon.

h08.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h08.content: He plays a single ukulele in a rocking chair on the porch, eyes closed, golden hour.

h09.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h09.content: He presents a small handmade ceramic bowl to his wife at the kitchen table with both hands, quietly proud; she beams.

h10.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, warm golden lighting, soft diffused light, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same man appears: mid 50s, salt-and-pepper beard, glasses, flannel shirt.
h10.content: Wide shot: the porch at sunset, the man in the rocking chair, one pottery wheel visible through the open garage door, everything calm and spare.

h11.content: Minimal end card for a television pharmaceutical commercial: flat solid cream background, the word HOBBYSTATIN in large elegant dark serif capital letters centered, beneath it in smaller letters the tagline: You already have a hobby. A small amber pill bottle sits below the text. Clean flat studio typography, no gradients. The small bottle's label shows only the word HOBBYSTATIN in tiny letters and no other text.
